observation.subject: GET /admin/catalog/products
observation.sentence: `GET /admin/catalog/products`: warm median 28 ms over 40 requests; Response write 77 %, Handler, other work 12 %, SQL 10 %. First request 2.0 ms (cold).
whatToCheck: Most of the time is writing the response: check its size and any lazy loading during serialization.
Open the slowest exemplar request in Live Activity to see its timeline.
limitations: Some requests ran on virtual threads, whose CPU time and allocation the JVM does not report per thread: Profile resources samples them with JFR.
39 warm requests reached no handler BootUI marks (an Actuator endpoint, a request the security filters answered, or a servlet outside Spring MVC), so they are left out of the phases.
